notes: Pack and riding animals and vehicles (Plan 4, B1). capacity is the kg of cargo each carries, against 20 kg per member at STR 10; a ridden horse's capacity is what it carries besides its rider. waterPerDay is in days of a member's water (2 kg each), doubled in the desert. Owned animals cost no upkeep (designer call 2026-11-13: mounts have no upkeep and a higher price instead; pack animals and vehicles follow the same rule, since their keep was coin for fodder and stabling, not the party's food), so price is the whole cost of owning one: raised from 5/8/50/50/75/15/35 gp to make each a real decision for a 10–50 gp party. Only riding animals are hired (hirePerDay, per member, for a journey to a settlement). Riding speed is 2× (1.25× in mountains, marsh and jungle, A4). maxPathDanger keeps horses and camels off rough paths to sites; carts and wagons keep to roads.
